title: SimulationConfig
description: Everything a simulator needs to build and run a site. Written with the LIF file, in its map frame. Metres and radians; mesh paths are relative to this file.

doors.description: Building doors. Empty when the site has none. Lift cabin doors are listed under their lift.

lifts.description: Lifts joining floors. Empty when the site has none.

stations.description: Points where a robot interacts with the site, such as picking up or dropping off a load. Empty when the site has none.

Messaging.description: How robots and devices connect to the fleet controller over MQTT.

device_interface.description: First segment of device topics, such as a lift's: {device_interface}/v1/{manufacturer}/{device_id}/...

vda5050_version.description: VDA5050 protocol version the robots speak, e.g. '2.1.0'.

MeshPath.description: A glTF binary (.glb) file, as a path relative to this file. No absolute paths and no '..'.

map_id.description: Floor id. Matches a mapId in the LIF file. Unique.

name.description: Floor name as people know it, e.g. 'Ground floor'.

elevation.description: Height of the floor surface in metres.

visual_mesh.description: The floor's walls, floor areas and fixed models, for display.

collision_mesh.description: The same, simplified for collision checks.

Door.description: A building door, given by the two ends of its doorway. Its kind decides how it opens.

map_id.description: Floor the door is on. Matches a floor's map_id.

left_end.description: Left end of the doorway, [x, y] in metres.

right_end.description: Right end of the doorway, [x, y] in metres.

slides_towards.description: The end the door slides towards when it opens.

map_id.description: Floor the door is on. Matches a floor's map_id.

left_end.description: Left end of the doorway, [x, y] in metres.

right_end.description: Right end of the doorway, [x, y] in metres.

left_right_ratio.description: Width of the left panel divided by the width of the right panel. 1 means equal panels.

map_id.description: Floor the door is on. Matches a floor's map_id.

left_end.description: Left end of the doorway, [x, y] in metres.

right_end.description: Right end of the doorway, [x, y] in metres.

pivot_on.description: The end the door's hinge is on.

map_id.description: Floor the door is on. Matches a floor's map_id.

left_end.description: Left end of the doorway, [x, y] in metres.

right_end.description: Right end of the doorway, [x, y] in metres.

left_right_ratio.description: Width of the left panel divided by the width of the right panel. 1 means equal panels.

SwingAngle.description: How far the door opens, in radians.

Swing.description: Which way a swing door opens, and how far. 'Forward' and 'backward' are the two sides of the doorway.

name.description: Lift name. Unique and stable. Also the device_id in its device topics.

manufacturer.description: Lift manufacturer. The {manufacturer} segment of its device topics.

center.description: Centre of the cabin, [x, y] in metres. The same on every floor.

yaw.description: Rotation of the cabin, in radians.

cabin_doors.description: One entry per cabin face that has a door.

initial_map_id.description: Floor the cabin starts on. Matches a floor's map_id, and a floor at least one cabin door opens on.

face.description: Cabin face the door is on. Each face appears at most once per lift.

opens_on.description: Floors this door opens on. Each matches a floor's map_id. The lift serves every floor listed by any of its doors.

station_id.description: Station id. Matches a stationId in the LIF file. Unique.

map_id.description: Floor the station is on. Matches a floor's map_id.

position.description: [x, y] in metres, or [x, y, yaw] when the station has a heading.

station_type.description: How a load is handled here, e.g. 'floor' or 'rack'. The pick action's stationType.

load_type.description: Kind of load handled here, e.g. 'EPAL'. The pick action's loadType.

manufacturer.description: Robot manufacturer. The {manufacturer} segment of its robot topics.

serial.description: Robot serial number. Same as name.

model.description: Robot model. Matches a vehicleTypeId in the LIF file.

map_id.description: Floor the robot starts on. Matches a floor's map_id and a mapId in the LIF file.
